thesis: MORNING (11:00 ET) read ~90 minutes into the Friday 2026-08-14 session, with the Thursday 2026-08-13 close (SPY 777.88, a fresh 52-week high) still the LAST COMPLETED daily bar — so persistence still counts by completed bars and the live 8/14 tape is an in-progress session, not a new completed bar. WHAT THE MORNING SETTLED: the open HELD its key levels and did not change the plan. SPY gapped a benign +0.1% and 90 minutes in trades 777.19 (pctFrom52wHigh -0.09, essentially back at the high), holding its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (+3.82% over its 50-day ~748.6, +10.59% over its 200-day ~702.8, mom126/252 +14.69%/+21.85%); intraday-tape-lab reads the 8/14 session a Range day auction under Retail-driven control around VWAP 778.09 (14 bars, gap +0.1%) — an orderly hold, not a rejection and not a trend-break. The dealer cushion is intact and re-confirmed on today's read: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (asOf 2026-08-14T10:14:17Z, dealer spot 778.56) read SPY in POSITIVE dealer gamma with the flip DOWN at 773.14 and the spot well above it, signed net GEX +11.98B, put wall 777, call wall 780, playbook pin-to-maxpain / conviction patient, hold same-session-fade, atmIV 10.96% (below the calm headline VIX 14.58) and a front expected move of ±3.16 (~±0.41%, a band near ~775.4-781.7 off the 778.56 spot) — so dealers dampen and pin, and SPY sits mid-range between the 777 put wall and the 780 call wall. Intraday participation stays broad: market-heatmap-lab reads 65.06% of 134 constituents positive against the 60% broad-market threshold (broad, margin +5.06). But this is a LIVE intraday reading, not a completed bar: completed-bar breadth held above 60% on 8/7 (61.77%) and 8/10 (60.25%), broke on 8/11 (56.47%) and 8/12 (49.85%), and re-reclaimed on the completed 8/13 close (65.06%) — so exactly ONE completed bar sits back above the line and today's 8/14 close is the candidate for a second. PLAN, structure-first and unchanged by the morning: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core — the 20>50>200 bull-stack is intact, SPY is back at its fresh-high area and SPMO holds above its 50-day with mom21 positive. HOLD the FIRST measured beta-add tranche already staged on the completed 8/13 60%-plus breadth reclaim, sized on the x1.13 throttle; keep the remaining tranches gated until a SECOND completed close (today's 8/14 close is the candidate) holds breadth above 60% for three-bar persistence while SPMO holds above ~150.5 and SPY holds above the 773.14 flip. Open risk into the close: the 8/14 calendar has no scheduled high-importance release, the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28, and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items.
